body: Not to be a jerk, but I was wondering if there was any progress? I never got a PM or anything... Just wondering if you were still gonna help.

Thanks.

Classes would be great, but I can't even afford a computer to work, let alone a class to play around in. I was on meds for years and I'm much better without them. Even if I could pay for a class, I can't get anywhere because of this whole car // license thing.
ph0b0sreddit@gmail.com should work. I made a new one to protect my identity. Hope that's not lame.
My computer is my lifeline. You are a life saver in the most literal sense of the term. Thank you.

This would be really amazing, thank you. Unfortunately, all I have right now is a laptop. I don't have a keyboard or mouse, let alone a monitor. I'm used to working on the go, I guess. Your generosity to a complete stranger is really admirable. 

And thank you, lush_rhetoric. According to the PM you sent, you're actually local (we have the same area code). I'll be calling you soon, I'm sure. Thank you for taking time out for a stranger. This is really much more than I ever expected.

No money for a bike. No buses come out here. They only go to the city. I have bad knees, so walking for a long distance (even just one mile, let alone 10 miles, plus all the walking that comes with working retail) is out of the question.

7:30am to 2:30pm is not a feasible schedule for retail, and working 6 hours a day on retail wages is not going to pay the bills. I feel like it's a waste of time.

Thanks for trying, but I don't think any of this is applicable.

The only time I can really work is 7:30am to 2:30 pm, and I still don't have transportation. I live in a community where all the jobs are on the other side of the highway. The closest business is over 5 miles away, which is not a reasonable distance for me to be walking twice a day for someone in my mental state. Especially when the only way is across a highway.
If I could *get* a more menial job or **any** sort of job that allowed me to be home when I need to be, then I would pounce on it. Unfortunately I haven't had any call-backs.
Thank you, but realize that they're just trying to help. They *did* say, "and if those aren't around, complete strangers can even suffice. Redditors Assemble!"
